nodes.label: GPT-6 Sol Parser Specification
nodes.rationale: Parsing accepts only gpt-6-sol; rejects all other models before preprocessing or API access. Pydantic validates internal layout response shape.

nodes.label: GPT-6 Luna Chat Specification
nodes.rationale: Chat uses gpt-6-luna at medium reasoning, strict JSON schemas, store=False, no tools, 60s timeout, and no retries. Accepted answers require separate draft and verification calls.

nodes.label: Local Token Pricing Accounting
nodes.rationale: Tracks USD per million tokens locally in src/models.py for Sol and Luna for local run accounting rather than gateway billing.
